name: DVZ M-V new data center
notes: DVZ announced start of site setup for a new data center in Schwerin; completion planned for Q2 2027. Existing DVZ service page lists Schwerin address.

name: PLANET IC Schwerin 1
notes: Aggregator listings identify one PLANET IC colocation facility at Mettenheimer Strasse 9-15, 19061 Schwerin.

name: University of Greifswald Data Centre
developer: State of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern / University of Greifswald
notes: EU/MV project page says a new data center was built at Felix-Hausdorff-Strasse 12, Greifswald, with EUR 12.4m total investment; university release confirms the operational facility and sustainability award.

name: Landkreis Vorpommern-Greifswald technical data center
developer: Landkreis Vorpommern-Greifswald / E-TEC Power Management GmbH
notes: E-TEC reports handover of a secure, energy-efficient technical data center for the district with 12 racks and geothermal integration.

name: Pasewalk Berlin-Szczecin Industrial Park data center
notes: NDR reported negotiations for a several-hundred-million-euro data center in Pasewalk had failed after more than three years; Datacenter Insider described the planned investment as about EUR 800m.

name: WIIT Stralsund data centers
notes: WIIT states it operates two data centers in Stralsund at Zur Schwedenschanze 2 with over 600 m2 of data-center space and 146 racks.

name: Landkreis Vorpommern-Rügen Stralsund data center
developer: Landkreis Vorpommern-Rügen / Data Center Consulting GmbH
notes: Data Center Consulting reference says it planned and supported completion of a new RZ in Stralsund for Landkreis Vorpommern-Rügen.

name: regio iT EURaix Evolution data center
developer: regio iT gesellschaft fuer informationstechnologie mbh / Data Center Group
notes: regio iT announced the groundbreaking for a climate-neutral Aachen data center due to begin operation in mid-2025; later local reporting describes the new Schwarzen Weg facility starting operation.

name: RelAix Networks hex/AC
notes: RelAix lists server housing at Data Center hex/AC and gives the Aachen operator address Auf der Huels 172; company news says hex/AC is TÜV-certified.

name: CANCOM Aachen
notes: Data Center Map lists CANCOM Aachen at Im Suesterfeld 6, 52072 Aachen, with event history noting CANCOM acquired Synaix Group in July 2017.

name: Stadtwerke Bielefeld / BITel data center
notes: Stadtwerke Bielefeld describes a new TÜV-certified regional data center in Bielefeld/OWL with DIN EN 50600 design, ISO 27001 ISMS, PUE <= 1.3, dual 10-kV feeds, and four medium-voltage transformers.

name: euNetworks Colocation Bielefeld
notes: Listings identify euNetworks Colocation Bielefeld at Jahnplatz / Niederwall 2, 33602 Bielefeld; Datacenters.com reports 3,218 sq ft raised floor and ISO 27001.

name: GFR DataCenter Bochum

name: ITENOS Data Center Bonn
notes: ITENOS lists a Bonn data center with 375 m2 floor space, 160 kVA UPS expandable, 24/7 monitoring, and access controls.

name: NTT Rhein-Ruhr 1 / CGN1
notes: Listings identify NTT Rhein-Ruhr 1 / site code CGN1 at Friedrich-Woehler-Strasse 67, 53117 Bonn.

name: tops.net Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists tops.net Data Center at Holtorfer Strasse 35, 53229 Bonn, offering colocation and 19-inch server rack space.
